evidence.scope: Production shell, /_health, /api/top-scores, /api/community-stats and /api/profile; browser gameplay verified in the September 29 audit.

capabilities.label: Classic Survival
capabilities.benefit: Start a free endless arena run in the browser.

capabilities.label: Three authored Operations
capabilities.benefit: Choose routes through seven-encounter missions with local progression.

capabilities.label: Arcade modes
capabilities.benefit: Play Extraction, Bot Royale, Boss Gauntlet, Hold the Throne and seeded rulesets with distinct objectives.

capabilities.label: Your Sewer Record
capabilities.benefit: Review career and stash, download a credential-free save, and preview a restore on this device.

capabilities.label: Previewed challenge links
capabilities.benefit: Inspect a shared run's seed, mode, build, score scope and expiry before independent guest play. Friendly scores are self-reported, not a live match or verified result.

capabilities.label: Player-owned run pack
capabilities.benefit: Download a redacted, hashed JSON summary from a saved debrief for your own analysis or an AI agent; no upload or score attestation is included.

capabilities.label: Field Lab prototypes
capabilities.benefit: Try three authored, unranked tactics models for pressure routing, nemesis counters and paired practice; they do not change live Operations or scored runs.

capabilities.label: Squad codes
capabilities.benefit: Create or join a code locally and use it with supported score submissions.

capabilities.label: Public score board
capabilities.benefit: Read live top scores and community totals with stated coverage and trust limits.

capabilities.label: Field Manual and Bestiary
capabilities.benefit: Find controls, rules and enemy information in public guides.

capabilities.label: Cross-device career recovery
capabilities.benefit: Recover browser progress after verifying an active Obelisk session.

capabilities.label: Online duel results
capabilities.benefit: See a friend's independent response attached to a shared challenge.

capabilities.label: Daily board ghost
capabilities.benefit: Race a published board leader's path when one is available.

capabilities.label: Royale pacing from player evidence
capabilities.benefit: Tune bot count and flood timing after comparable playtests.

capabilities.label: Real-time co-op
capabilities.benefit: Play a shared arena with friends.

capabilities.label: Networked Toilet Royale
capabilities.benefit: Face other people instead of computer-controlled opponents.
